record.question: How many exchanges are typically done per day in CAPD?
record.explanation: Answer B: 3 – 5. CAPD is commonly prescribed as roughly four manual exchanges daily; NIDDK says usually at least four, and prescriptions may be individualized. Option “3–5” is the only range containing the standard schedule. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/kidney-failure/peritoneal-dialysis; https://www.medlineplus.gov/ency/article/007434.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
